objective: Deploy the exact approved interruption-safe reissue product to the existing public KEP Solana Devnet service while preserving PostgreSQL state and prohibiting protocol transactions.

current_state_guard.guard_rule: Before the first effect, one fresh read-only SSH preflight must prove every guard and required-path absence remains exact; any drift stops execution.

credential_references.reuse_scope: mode and identity checks only; neither credential value is transmitted, printed, replaced, or used by the application transition

recovery_material.rollback_posture: preserve only; rollback requires separate authorization

executor.candidate_digest_binding: The executor refuses to start unless CA2_KEP_DEPLOY_CANDIDATE_DIGEST equals the exact accepted digest of this candidate.

database_effect.startup_behavior: Re-evaluate existing idempotent migrations 001 and 002 only.
database_effect.preservation: The existing database container and kep-hosted-devnet_kep-postgres volume must retain their exact identities.
database_effect.forbidden: No restore, deletion, drop, volume replacement, database recreation, credential change, or destructive migration.

allowed_effects_in_order: validate the exact candidate digest, approved product digests, local image, archive, smoke evidence, executor, and credential file modes
perform one fresh read-only SSH current-state and required-path-absence preflight; stop before effects on mismatch
create one fresh nonempty mode-0600 PostgreSQL custom-format dump
upload the exact archive once and verify its remote digest and size
load the archive once and prove the exact tag and local-versus-remote semantic projection equality
copy the active Compose and mode-0600 environment to the exact rollback paths
derive and atomically promote the exact mode-0600 next environment by changing only KEP_IMAGE
run docker compose up -d --no-build --no-deps application once
perform bounded application and database health, unchanged database ID and volume, image identity, HTTPS, TLS, exact root and bundle bytes, and Solana Devnet identity reads
write one exact local execution receipt after the attempt ends
stop_conditions: missing or mismatched candidate, product approval, product material, product test, image, archive, smoke, executor, credential mode, or backup-envelope identity
any current-state, path, dump, upload, image, semantic projection, environment, activation, health, database, volume, HTTPS, TLS, network, root, or bundle mismatch
any failed or ambiguous external effect
execution_envelope.rollback_policy: none; preserve exact rollback material and stop
forbidden_effects: Mainnet, paid RPC fallback, protocol transaction, signature request, wallet use, airdrop, funding, consideration transfer, or SOL transfer
credential output, replacement, transmission, or reuse outside the declared mode and identity checks
database restore, deletion, drop, recreation, volume removal, image pruning, or destructive migration
unrelated VPS mutation, source substitution, automatic retry, or automatic rollback
publication, release, Git commit, Git push, reissue execution, live interruption test, or cleanup

risk_disclosure.availability: The application container will be replaced. A post-promotion failure must stop without automatic rollback and can leave the public service unavailable until separate rollback authorization.
risk_disclosure.backup: The PostgreSQL volume and a same-VPS mode-0600 dump are preserved, but this does not prove off-host backup or restore recovery.
risk_disclosure.transaction: No KEP protocol or Solana transaction is permitted.

claim_limit: Exact deployment candidate only. It does not authorize itself, SSH effects, dump creation, upload, image load, activation, deployment, rollback, transaction, publication, or release.
